title: Maglev Configuration
description: Configuration schema for the Maglev OneBusAway server

host.description: The address to bind the server to. Defaults to all interfaces when empty.

protected-api-keys.description: Protected API keys for sensitive endpoints

exempt-api-keys.description: API keys that are exempt from rate limiting

rate-limit.description: Requests per second per API key for rate limiting

gtfs-static-feed.description: Configuration for a single static GTFS feed. Cannot be combined with gtfs-static-feeds.

gtfs-static-feeds.description: Static GTFS feeds, in load order. Cannot be combined with gtfs-static-feed. Only the first feed is imported for now.

id.description: Unique identifier for this feed (auto-generated if missing)

agency-ids.description: Optional subset of agency IDs that this feed provides data for

trip-updates-url.description: URL for a GTFS-RT trip updates feed

vehicle-positions-url.description: URL for a GTFS-RT vehicle positions feed

service-alerts-url.description: URL for a GTFS-RT service alerts feed

realtime-auth-header-name.description: Optional header name for GTFS-RT auth (legacy)

realtime-auth-header-value.description: Optional header value for GTFS-RT auth (legacy)

headers.description: Optional HTTP headers to send with requests to this feed

data-path.description: Path to the SQLite database containing GTFS data (cannot contain '..' for security)

tls-cert-path.description: Path to TLS certificate file. When set together with tls-key-path, the server serves HTTPS.

tls-key-path.description: Path to TLS private key file. When set together with tls-cert-path, the server serves HTTPS.

id.description: Unique name for this feed in logs and metrics (default: feed-{n})

url.description: URL for a static GTFS zip file (http/https URLs or local file paths)

default-agency-id.description: Agency ID for entities in this feed that name no agency. Must be unique across feeds and must not contain '_'. Validated but not applied until multi-feed import lands.

agency-id-mappings.description: Renames agency IDs from agency.txt and routes.txt, old value to new value. New values must be non-empty and must not contain '_'. Validated but not applied until multi-feed import lands.

auth-header-name.description: Optional header name for static GTFS feed authentication

auth-header-value.description: Optional header value for static GTFS feed authentication

headers.description: Optional HTTP headers to send with requests for this feed. Not applied until multi-feed import lands; use auth-header-name/auth-header-value for now.

enable-gtfs-tidy.description: Enable GTFS tidying with gtfstidy tool (requires gtfstidy to be installed)
